eps.o: Eight-year-old genius inventor Tony Stark (aka Iron Man) gives a tour of the IQ.
Iron Man must rescue people from a Ferris wheel when it stops working.
Ironheart, Iron Man, and Iron Hulk race to rescue a giant runaway donut in their Iron Racers.
Iron Hulk helps rescue a kitten that's trapped in a tree.
The Iron Friends must get Iron Pup's flying disc back after Absorbing Man steals it.
Iron Man and Captain America work together when Swarm attacks the IQ with her robotic lightning bug.
Iron Man and Iron Spider must save the pier when Swarm makes a mess of it with her robotic bugs.
When Swarm uses her robotic slime bug to make a mess of Stark Expo, it's up to Iron Man and Black Panther to rescue the visitors and save the day.
Iron Man must stop Ultron when he uses his robotic racer to steal things from people all over town.
When the training bots go out of control in the Smashcade, Iron Man needs Vision's help to get everything back in working order.
The Iron Friends use their new giant-sized armor.
The Iron Friends use their Iron Jet to defeat Swarm.
Iron Man and Ironheart build Thor a new car.
Iron Man and Giant-Man help build a monorail.
Ultron has new giant-sized armor.
Iron Man and Hawkeye train in the Smashcade.
Iron Man and Iron Hulk stop Loki on the pier.
Iron Man and Captain America stop Absorbing Man.
Black Panther helps Iron Man and Ironheart stop Swarm.
Ultron interrupts Tony and his dad's band performance.
